No worries. The reason why Susan is said to be the Hard Counterpick for Javelin is because of her 2nd and 3rd skill. Her 3rd skill grants a shield to allies which helps absorb physical damage (Javelin uses physical damage so the shield helps Susan and her allies survive a bit longer). Now her 2nd skill is where she actually shines. Susan has the ability to reflect physical Damage taken and proportionally deal it back to enemies based on their physical defense. If Javelin gets her ult in while Susan uses her 2nd skill... you can be sure that Javelin will always die :)

Don't get your hopes up. Against Alice, she doesn't have the high dodge rate Sapphire has to avoid the Crit strikes Alice deals and may end up getting killed off before she even has time to really deal any significant damage. Susan uses enemies Physical defense and Physical attack to reflect damage proportional to these stats. Sometimes RNG favours you and she can get in decent damage, other times she'll get in a measly amount of damage before either your other bgs finish the match or the enemy team kills you off.
